'''Cygnats''' were biting pests [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="TPMVD" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]]. Dense [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="TPMVD" /> like that of the [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] also found on Thisspias,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|237|Thisspias}}</ref> deterred cygnats. The Thisspiasian [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] had a beard of dense hair that detered the pests.<ref name="TPMVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cygnats were first mentioned in the [[1999]] reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], which was written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="TPMVD" />
